[[File:Tyia.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A Revwien wearing a Tyia amulet.]]
'''Tyia amulet''' were representative of the [[Tyia]] philosophy. These amulets had a triangular centerpiece to which were attached green<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'', Second Edition]],168</ref> or opalescent beads, as well as green discs.<ref name="Jedi Academy">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]'', 86-87</ref>
